initiatives.title: STRIVE
initiatives.subtitle: A World Bank project on skills
initiatives.summary: CMIA is the only industry chamber in Maharashtra selected to implement the STRIVE scheme.
initiatives.detail: STRIVE was launched to improve the relevance and efficiency of skill training delivered through ITIs, and to strengthen apprenticeships.
initiatives._photo_note: PLACEHOLDER — the old site's STRIVE image (admin/upload_initiatives/1558087568_STRIVE news.JPG) returns 404. Source the press clipping or a programme photograph.
initiatives._documents_note: These were listed as links on the old Skill Hub page but the files were not reachable. Place the PDFs in public/downloads/strive/ and add a `href` to each entry.

initiatives.title: MOU with the Electronics Sector Skill Council
initiatives.summary: Signed for skill development activity — helping CMIA get courses approved to run BTP batches for PCB assembly operators.
initiatives._photo_note: PLACEHOLDER — the old site's MOU image returns 404.

initiatives.title: MAGIC
initiatives.subtitle: Marathwada Accelerator for Growth and Incubation Council
initiatives.summary: The chamber's incubator, set up to back new ventures in the region. An MOU was signed with NIELIT.

initiatives.title: Joint summit with Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Marathwada University
initiatives.summary: On technical education and its improvement, held at the university campus, with leading industrialists from the region guiding the discussion.

initiatives.title: Lighting, LED and rooftop solar conclave
initiatives.summary: Held at the CSMSS college campus and inaugurated by CMIA President Mr. Bagga. The Hon. Energy Minister of Maharashtra, Mr. Bawankule, attended.

initiatives.title: SuryaKumbh
initiatives.subtitle: The world's largest solar cooking festival
initiatives.summary: Held with Simplified Technologies to promote renewable energy among school students. Each student built a solar oven and cooked lunch in it.
initiatives.detail: The festival entered the Guinness World Records and the Limca Book of Records.

initiatives.title: Jet Airways umbrella tie-up
initiatives.summary: An agreement giving CMIA members negotiated terms on air bookings.
initiatives._note: Historical. Jet Airways no longer operates as it did when this agreement was made; kept as part of the record.

initiatives.title: Donation to Arambh Society
initiatives.summary: Part of the chamber's community work.

initiatives.title: Oxygen Rich MIDC
initiatives.summary: A tree plantation programme across the industrial area.
initiatives._photo_note: PLACEHOLDER — no photograph on the old site. Worth shooting; a planting day is highly photographable.

skillHub.name: Marathwada Skill Hub
skillHub.quote: The more we give importance for skill development, the more competent will be our youth.
skillHub.summary: CMIA at the centre, its member companies as the support — a single connecting point for everyone training youth in the region.
skillHub.detail: In the long run the Skill Hub acts as the point of connection for all the key agencies in skills training: industry members, academic institutes and state government agencies.
skillHub.belief: A better world evolves through the combined accomplishments of committed, socially responsive and compassionate organisations focused on Make in India through Skill India.
